newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain union warns govt to keep out of labour talks.
newsitem.headline: Spain union warns govt to keep out of labour talks.

text.p: Spain's leading union warned on Monday that if the government intervened in labour talks and forced reforms it would lead to social unrest.

"A unilateral reform enforced by the government and its parliamentary colleagues would be a failure and would generate unrest and undoubtedly social conflict," Antonio Gutierrez, leader of the Workers' Commision (CCOO) union told a news conference.
Spain's union and employer leaders are due to meet on Tuesday in a last attempt to reach an agreement.
The government had previously given the two parties until the beginning of March to reach a deal before it steps in and forces an accord.
Local media reported that the fundamental disagreement between the two lay in reducing dismissal costs.
Employers want unfair dismissal costs reduced to 25 days per year worked, from a current level of 45 days.
